description: This file defines the Express router for analytics endpoints, including routes for retrieving LLM cost data by agent and new user counts over time. It includes Swagger annotations for API documentation, request logging, and route handlers that invoke controller functions.

methods.name: head('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Provides lightweight health check for the LLM cost-by-agent endpoint, returning 204 status.

methods.name: options('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles CORS preflight request, returning 204 status.

methods.name: get('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for LLM cost distribution by agent, with request logging and invocation of controller.

methods.name: get('/users/new-over-time')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve new users over time, invoking corresponding controller.
